lemmas.primary_translation: to make up one's mind / to show one's stance

definitions.translation: to make up one's mind (lit. to jump/come down from the fence)

examples.no: velgene ventet lenge med å hoppe ned fra gjerdet
examples.en: the voters waited a long time before getting off the fence

examples.no: de har vært avventende, men nå kommer de ned fra gjerdet
examples.en: they've been hesitant, but now they're getting off the fence
